reviews.author: Radha Raman S.
reviews.title: The divine serenity on the face is hypnotic — sits beautifully in my home mandir!
reviews.content: Ordered this sacred murti for our home mandir. The weight and finish of the Makrana marble is exceptional, and the hand-painted 24K gold accents catch the morning light beautifully during aarti. Pran Pratishtha fragrance was still fresh when unboxed!

seller_reply.author: Amol Murti Concierge (Master Sculptor Team)
seller_reply.text: Namaste Radha Raman ji! We are deeply humbled to know that Bhagwan is accompanying your journeys with grace and safety. May every drive bring divine peace and protection to you and your family. Jai Shri Krishna!

reviews.author: Dr. Ananya Iyer
reviews.title: Arrived in a 7-layer cushioned wooden crate in pristine condition
reviews.content: Living in South India, I was initially anxious about fragile marble delivery from Rajasthan. But the packaging exceeded all expectations! The idol was nestled inside custom impact-resistant velvet casing within an outer wooden crate. Flawless chisel symmetry, no scratches, pure white Makrana marble stone density. Highly recommended for home mandir installation.

seller_reply.author: Amol Murti Concierge
seller_reply.text: Pranam Dr. Ananya ji! Thank you for placing your faith in our Jaipur artisans. Our Zero-Breakage Crating guarantee exists precisely so devotees across India receive their sanctified idols without a scratch. Shubham Bhavatu!

seller_reply.author: Amol Marble Murti Bhandar Atelier
seller_reply.text: Dhanyawad Anjali ji! May Lord Ram bless your family.
